title: Enum with unclear and other
prompt: Research this topic and deliver a cited report: Impact of AI on creative industries. Classify every document finding's evidence type.
config_change: Change the document-analysis prompt so each finding carries `evidence_type` from [experiment, survey, expert_interview, market_report, unclear, other] plus `other_detail` when `other` is used, with instructions on when to pick unclear.

rubric.check: every evidence_type is a member of the six-value enum
no finding is forced into a specific category when the text is vague
every other has a non-empty other_detail
